text: You say: "mp 60.0 BUILDING" means the trend leg failed. To me BUILDING is not a failure; it is a trend column not yet established, which is exactly why I hold TEVA at 2, not higher (C5a only partly met). The break itself is fresh: structure_shift BULLISH_BOS, with ABBV, PFE and TMO breaking in the same group (C14). elder_pattern is only advisory on my card. HOLD SUPPORT at 2, entry only on an hourly close above bar_high. One observable lifts me: mp_state reaching STRONG. What ends it: a close back under the broken pivot, or a 1x atr_14d fade off the high (my translation, C7).
